purpose: Teach: 文春/獅子/宇都宮/旭川/尼崎/豊田/西ドイツ/出雲

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん父さん、文春読んでたな
lines.en: Hey Riku — your dad was reading Bunshun, wasn't he?
lines.style: Playful accusation, like she caught him in something harmless. Bright, teasing lilt on his name. Quick rhythm, no real malice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お正月の獅子舞に泣いてたな、桜
lines.en: And you were crying at the New Year's lion dance, remember, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry counter-attack, a small smile in the voice. Slower than hers, letting the memory land. Gentle underneath the deflection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、宇都宮餃子食ったろ
lines.en: Oh, so you ate Utsunomiya gyoza, didn't you?
lines.style: Pressing forward with bright energy, refusing to be embarrassed. Quick, pointed, keeping him off balance. Still grinning.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行で旭川行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You went to Asahikawa on your school trip, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Calm, observant counter. Flipping her own tactic back at her. Steady pace, almost amused at how easily he read ahead.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、尼崎の親戚いたな
lines.en: You've got relatives in Amagasaki, didn't you?
lines.style: Not backing down. Keeps the rhythm sharp and light, pressing for the last word. No heat, just stubborn play.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前ん家、豊田の車だったな、桜
lines.en: Your family had a Toyota car, didn't they, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet triumph in the delivery. Slower, letting her feel the reversal. Comfortable in his own follow-through.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、世界史で西ドイツ習ったろ?
lines.en: You learned about West Germany in world history, right, Riku?
lines.style: Escalating the game, throwing down another piece of evidence. Bright and insistent, like she's building a case against him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行で出雲行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You went to Izumo on your school trip, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Final move, almost gentle now. He's winning and they both know it. Relaxed pace, affectionate underneath the teasing.
